title: feat(service-storage): the sys_attachment read gate writes one ReadableIds leaf per parent object and does no pre-scan; D5's three classes keep the probe (ADR-0139 E7, attachments)
body:
Part of #23732
Clause-②: yes (the re-exported installAttachmentReadVisibility takes an optional third argument, and its declaration now reaches two more types; amended by the seat, see below)

ADR-0139 row E7 (D4, D5), the attachment gate only. #23732 stays open for its other two gates: measured on `origin/main`, the comment-thread gate has no pointer pair to write D4's branch over, and the comment-reaction gate's one parent is a D5.2 class, so it keeps the probe by the ADR's own text. Both are set out under "What this PR does not switch, and why" below, with the decision they need. #22788 stays open too; this PR touches neither of its remaining items.

## What changed

`packages/services/service-storage/src/attachment-access-hooks.ts`, `installAttachmentReadVisibility`:

- **The leaf (D4).** For every object the metadata registry holds, except `sys_attachment` itself, the gate writes one branch over the row's own pointer pair, `{ parent_object: P, parent_id: { $in: ReadableIds.of(P) } }`. The branches are ORed and ANDed into the read's `where`. For a leaf parent the gate makes no engine call at all: no SYSTEM pre-scan, and no caller-scoped read of `P`. The engine composes the leaf at its executor boundary from the security service's `canReadObject` and `getReadFilter` for `P`, and `driver-sql` compiles it to one subquery inside its tenant wall. So a list, its `total` and a grouped count are each one statement over every row the caller may read, with no candidate window.
- **D5's three classes keep the bounded probe, chosen up front** (`planAttachmentParentReads`, which reads the context, the registry, the middleware registrations and the datasource bindings, and asks nothing and reads no row):
  1. a delegated (on-behalf-of) caller, by the engine's own test (`onBehalfOf.userId`): the whole read is the probe;
  2. a parent an object-scoped read middleware narrows (`hasObjectMiddleware`): that parent's rows go through the probe, its SYSTEM pre-scan restricted to rows naming those parents;
  3. a parent bound to another datasource than `sys_attachment` (`resolveEffectiveDatasource`): the same restricted probe.

  The probe is never reached by catching a refusal. Its body is the gate's existing pre-scan (2,000 rows, fail-closed, said once per read past the bound), plus the restriction to the probed parents.
- **E5's guard, taken as the card carries it.** No leaf is written unless the security service answers `canReadObject`. With `explain` only, with no service, or when the source throws, the whole read is the probe, and the gate says so once per engine. So does an engine without the three classifying questions. Without the guard a security-less stack would hide every attachment from every caller (the engine answers each leaf `$in: []` there), and an `explain`-only service would admit a SYSTEM-context leaf as nothing.
- **D3.** The middleware no longer wraps anything in a catch. The probe's own failure is answered with the deny-all sentinel inside the gate and said. A composition or driver refusal raised by `next()` reaches the caller as `INTERNAL_ERROR` / 500 naming the driver and the leaf, never as deny-all.
- **Narrowing only:** a read whose probe finds no candidate row is now narrowed to deny-all rather than left unfiltered (what E5 did for its two gates). The pre-scan found nothing, so nothing is lost; the race it closes is a row written between the pre-scan and the read.
- **Interim letter C:** never landed on any of the three gates. None of them carries a located-400 refusal on `origin/main`, so there was nothing to retire, as E5 found for its two (ruling W).

`packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-service-plugin.ts` passes the security service, resolved on every read, as the installer's new optional third argument.

### Why the planner is local, not E5's module

E5's `planParentReads` and helpers live in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/parent-record-read-gate.ts`. plugin-audit's entry does not export that module, and service-storage depends on plugin-audit only as a devDependency. Reusing it needs a new plugin-audit export and a runtime edge from service-storage to plugin-audit, which also pulls `@objectstack/objectql` into service-storage's runtime closure. That moves a published surface. So the planner is local and mirrors E5's function for function. The definition both copies share is the engine's own D5 test (`ObjectQL#refuseUncomposableReadableIdsClasses`). One shared helper would belong in `@objectstack/core` beside `resolveReadableParentIds`, which is outside this claim (noted below).

The exported `installAttachmentReadVisibility` gains one optional trailing parameter. Every existing call keeps compiling and gets the probe, said once. That widens the re-exported installer's accept set, so `Clause-②: yes` (line 2). The precedent `ce3d0ad419` was declared `no (narrowing)` and does not carry (seat edit, per the contract record `6206226603`).

## What this PR does not switch, and why

1. **Comment threads: `sys_comment` has no pointer pair.** Its parent is one text column, `thread_id`, spelled `{object}:{record_id}` (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-comment.object.ts`). The leaf is a `$in` comparand on a field and stands for P's `id` values, so it compiles to "field IN (SELECT id FROM P ...)" (D1, D3). No branch of D4's shape can be written over `thread_id`. A switch needs either a pointer pair on `sys_comment` (two writer-stamped columns, the re-point rule, and a backfill of stored rows, in E6's shape) or a second leaf form, which D1 rules out. That is a decision for the card's owner, not this PR. It is filed as `needs_decision` in the dev report on the card.
2. **Comment reactions: the one parent is D5.2.** A reaction's parent is `sys_comment`, and the comment-thread gate narrows `sys_comment` with an object-scoped read middleware. D5.2's list names `sys_comment`. So under the ADR's text the reaction gate keeps the bounded probe on every read, and a leaf over `sys_comment` would be refused by the engine. The plan row's pin for reactions (a reader past 2,000 candidates sees every visible reaction) cannot be met under D5.2. The row and D5 disagree, and that is the owner's call, as with E5's activity pins.

## Readings (ADR-0139 O2): each gate's bound case, before and after

Fixture: one parent record per row, 2,300 owned by the member, 300 by another member, plus a vault the member may not read, a deleted parent, a dangling id, an unregistered object and a self-reference. Before means base `3b46855fb9`; after means this head.

| gate | stack | rows at rest | member may read | member served / total, before | after | administrator total, before | after |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| attachments | real engine, `SqlDriver` (sqlite `:memory:`), stand-in security | 2,608 | 2,302 | 1,755 / 1,755 | **2,302 / 2,302** | 1,998 of 2,604 | **2,604** |
| comment threads | real engine, `SqliteWasmDriver`, `AuditPlugin`, stand-in security (scratch suite, deleted) | 2,601 | 2,300 | 1,765 / 1,765 | unchanged | 2,000 of 2,601 | unchanged |
| comment reactions | the same, one reaction per comment | 2,601 | 2,300 | 1,763 / 1,763 | unchanged | 2,000 of 2,601 | unchanged |

On the real dogfood stack (the real `SecurityPlugin`; 2,481 candidate rows, 80 the member may read), the member's broad read dropped 16 visible rows before. After, it is served all 80, `total` 80, with no cap warning. The same stack writes 65 leaves per read (74 registered objects; 8 parents with an object-scoped read middleware go to the probe, and none of them holds an attachment). A member's first broad read took 242 ms there; this is a shared-box reading, not a verdict. On the sqlite fixture, a member's find over 2,608 rows took 11.5 ms after vs 36.7 ms before, and a count 6.9 ms vs 24.7 ms (shared box).

## Pins

- `src/attachment-read-leaf.integration.test.ts` (new; real engine and driver, 10 cases): the member and a second member are served exactly the readable set past the window, with `count` equal to the rows; the administrator gets a page of 20 over a true total; no vault, deleted-parent, dangling, unregistered or self-referencing row is served; a broad read logs no refusal and reads neither the doc nor the vault as the caller; there is one leaf per enumerated parent, and the middleware-gated and federated parents are probed beside them; a delegated caller gets the whole-read probe, bounded and never wider than the truth; the O2 reading; and on a refusing driver, `find` and `count` both fail with `{ code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', status: 500 }` and the driver's name.
- `src/attachment-read-leaf.test.ts` (new; stand-in engine, 20 cases): which branch each parent gets, and that a leaf costs no read; each D5 class; the four security-source states and the three engine gaps, each said once; a restricted probe's failure denies all; a probe past the bound names its class; `next()`'s refusal propagates.
- `src/attachment-read-visibility.test.ts`: one case re-pinned to the narrowing above. Every other case passes unchanged on the whole-read probe.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/attachments-parent-rls-scan-cap.dogfood.test.ts`: rewritten for the other side of the bound (its `@proof` tag is kept). Past the old window the member is served every visible row with a true total and no truncation is announced. The security direction holds: no invisible-parent row and no dangling-parent row, while the owner reads the hidden row.
- #23663's zero-denial pins (`parent-read-gate-silent-skip.dogfood.test.ts`) are untouched and green.

**Ablations**, each red, then restored and proved (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; the dogfood leg by dist preflight):

| leg | mutation | red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A0 | the gate file at base `3b46855fb9` (blob `d6f749b45d`) | src suites 25 of 53 red; dogfood 2 of 3 red (16 visible rows dropped; the owner's hidden row outside the window); controls green |
| A1 | delegated routing deleted | 3 |
| A2 | middleware-gated parents not probed | 10 |
| A3 | federated parents not probed | 8 |
| A4 | the `canReadObject` guard deleted | 4 |
| A5 | the consumer catches `next()`'s refusal into deny-all | 2 |
| A6 | a probe failure falls open | 1 |
| A7 | no branch leaves the read unfiltered | 4 |

The A0 dogfood leg rebuilt service-storage. Its DTS step failed (TS2554: the HEAD plugin passes a third argument to the base installer), but its JS reached `dist/`: `ablation-dist-preflight` found the base marker present (exit 0). The restore leg rebuilt green, the base marker was absent and the new marker present, and the tree was clean. A1 to A7 mutate src, which these suites import directly, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`.

## Gates

Local, on this head `a664ab3e55` (main `a869ea6362` merged in): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage test` (59 files, 1,021 tests, all passed) and `typecheck` for service-storage and dogfood (exit 0). The 13 dogfood suites that read `sys_attachment`: 122 passed, 1 skipped by design. The silent-skip, comments and activity suites: 20 passed. The union of the 71 commands `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives from this change set: 71 of 71 exit 0, and `--ran` reports 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. CI's check-runs are the verdict for every family CI runs.

## Acceptance notes

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/attachments-storage.json`, item `attachments-storage.read-inherits-parent-rls`: its `automated.ref` and `knownGaps` describe clause 3's 2,000-row fail-closed cap for a broad read. A broad read over an ordinary parent no longer reaches that cap; the rewritten pin keeps the `@proof` tag. The checklist is a QA ledger outside this PR's claimed surface. Carrier: none.
- `driver-mongodb`: a `sys_attachment` read now fails `INTERNAL_ERROR` / 500 there. This is O3, a ruled consequence (ADR-0139 D3, Consequences); the changeset says so.
- The D5 classification now exists twice in consumers (plugin-audit's gate module and this one) beside the engine's. One shared helper in `@objectstack/core` would make that one. Carrier: the `domain:engine` lane's #22788. Noted, not filed.
- The restricted probe runs its SYSTEM pre-scan for the middleware-gated parents on every broad read, even when none of them holds an attachment (measured on the dogfood stack: 8 such parents, 0 rows). That is a bounded cost, not a wrong answer.

## Seat append (patch round)

`domain:services` seat 1 (#6021) · `os-bill` · `session_017WLmd5in9RXu7AjyHR8fKQ`. Line 2 above was `Clause-②: no` as the dev wrote it. The contract record `6205698995` (FAIL at `a664ab3e55`) judged that a false declaration: the installer is re-exported from `src/index.ts`, its accept set widens by an optional third argument, and its declaration reaches two more types. The seat agrees and amended the claim at `6204165226` with `6205720011`. The changeset level stays `minor`. The dev's patch round flips the changeset's own `Clause-②:` line and brings the QA checklist item `attachments-storage.read-inherits-parent-rls` in line with the leaf. A new contract record is owed on the new head.

Round 2 (`6206226603`, PASS at `39991560cd`): the sentence that gave the withdrawn `no` rationale is rewritten above, as the record asks. The checklist item's two precision notes are carried to #23732 for the item's next revision.
